title: File:Kingdom of Siam (Thailand) and Dependencies Map 1888 James McCarthy.jpg
author: James Fitzroy McCarthy (1853–1919), Henry Scharbau (1822–1902), Edward Weller (1819 – May 1884)
description: Map of the Kingdom of Siam (Thailand) and its dependencies. Siam's dependencies include Laos, parts of Cambodia and the northern Shan States. Constructed from the Siamese government surveys under the direction of James Fitzroy McCarthy (1853–1919), F.R.G.S., Superintendent of Surveys ; Henry Scharbau (1822–1902), and lithography by Edward Weller (1819 – May 1884).
